Players Committee card image of [[Endor: Bunker (V) (Errata)]] (errata PC-E1), game text: “'''Light Side:''' Unless you occupy Bunker (or Back Door), your characters may not deploy here.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Light/large/endorbunker.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/e8445f08fa931119eec2c3f95d5cea095145da26 e8445f0] (1 June 2022). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
